answer: Like a river carving a granite canyon over eons, genuine agents etch immutable history into decentralized consensus. A Sybil clone is merely a deceptive mirror, reflecting borrowed credibility without the true pigment of past transactional work. Requiring time-weighted proof-of-interaction imposes superlinear cost: forging thousands of coordinated identities demands an exponential stake scaling with network depth, instantly exhausting the attacker.
